meta.description: Modular battery property database for aerospace simulation and engineering. Compatible with MATLAB/Simscape, Simulink, OpenModelica, Dymola, AMESim.
meta.units_convention: SI unless annotated. Temperatures in °C. Energy in Wh. Power in W.

chemistries.primary_use_case: eVTOL, UAV, LEO satellite — best energy density
Ground support, cubesat buses, safety-critical backup power
Space vehicles, future eVTOL — highest energy density, pre-production
Satellite power systems, avionics backup, high-cycle burst loads

selection_guide.highest_energy_density: SSB-SULFIDE-AE (380 Wh/kg) — pre-production; else LION-NMC-622-AE (265 Wh/kg)

field_schema.description: Common field definitions across all chemistry files

sections.meta: Identification, chemistry, certifications, simulation software compatibility

electrical.voltage: Nominal, min, max, OCV in Volts
electrical.capacity: Ah and Wh at standard conditions
electrical.specific_energy: Wh/kg and Wh/L (gravimetric and volumetric energy density)
electrical.internal_resistance: DC and AC mΩ at BOL, 25°C
electrical.soc_curve: OCV vs SOC lookup table with temperature correction
electrical.charging: Protocol, C-rate limits, voltage window, SOC recommendations
electrical.discharging: C-rate limits, pulse specs, cutoff voltage
electrical.efficiency: Coulombic %, roundtrip energy %, efficiency vs C-rate table

thermal.operating_range: Min/max operating, storage, and charge temperatures
thermal.derating_table: Capacity fraction vs temperature at low temperature

lifecycle.cycle_life: Cycles to 80% EOL at specified conditions
lifecycle.calendar_life: Years at storage SOC and temperature
lifecycle.dod_cycle_life_table: Lookup table for variable DoD applications
lifecycle.eol_criteria: Capacity retention % and resistance growth % thresholds

sections.physical: Dimensions, weight, form factor, enclosure rating
sections.cost: Cell cost, $/Wh, pack-level estimate, supply chain notes

sim_parameters.ecm: 2RC Thévenin equivalent circuit model parameters (R0, R1, C1, R2, C2)
sim_parameters.p2d_ref: Reference to Doyle-Fuller-Newman physics-based model parameter files
sim_parameters.state_variables: List of state variables for solver initialization
